decision: Session cookie secure flag must derive from x-forwarded-proto, not NODE_ENV: over plain http on a non-localhost host Chromium drops a Secure cookie, so newGameAction's request carried no session, proxy 307'd /game->/login, and game creation failed (games=0 while users grew)
